user.title: Set up Assist Satellite Notifier
user.description: Assist Satellite Notifier turns one Assist satellite into a notify service, so an alert or an automation can list it among its notifiers. Pick the satellite here; every other setting can be changed later from the integration's options.

data.prefix_title: Speak the title before the message

data_description.satellite: The assist_satellite entity that will announce. It must support announcements.
data_description.preannounce: Play the satellite's short chime before each announcement.
data_description.preannounce_media_id: Optional media ID or URL of a sound to play instead of the satellite's default chime.
data_description.prefix_title: When a call passes a title, speak it ahead of the message. Off by default: a spoken message has no title line.
data_description.deny_domains: Comma-separated entity domains. A call whose data.source_entity belongs to one of them is refused and logged instead of announced.
data_description.quiet_start: Start of the window during which announcements are held back. Leave empty to disable quiet hours.
data_description.quiet_end: End of the window. A window that ends before it starts wraps around midnight.
data_description.quiet_behaviour: What a call landing inside the window does. A call with priority critical in its data payload always goes through untouched.

abort.already_configured: This satellite is already configured for Assist Satellite Notifier.

error.satellite_cannot_announce: This satellite does not support announcements, so it can never speak a notification. Pick another one.
